votes.motion: Ratify the nominations of Director Mano for Board Chair and Director Dugan as Board Vice Chair
votes.description: The Board ratified the nomination of Darin Mano as Board Chair and Daniel Dugan as Board Vice Chair for the CRA Board of Directors.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent Agenda (reappointment of Rosa Bandeirinha and Nicholas Peterson to the Reinvestment Advisory Committee)
